newsitem.title: JAPAN: CSK sees special loss from unit's restructuring.
newsitem.headline: CSK sees special loss from unit's restructuring.

text.p: Information services company CSK Corp said on Friday it would include an extraordinary loss of 1.2 billion yen in its earnings in the second half of the current business year to March 31, 1997.
It said this was due to a planned restructuring of U.S. firm Micrognosis Inc, a unit of CSK subsidiary CSK International Corp.
CSK said the restructuring, which would begin after January 1997 was aimed at eliminating accumulated losses at the U.S. company.

CSK said Micrognosis would be divided into three firms which would eventually be involved in risk management and Internet businesses as well its existing business related to financial dealing systems.
CSK said the three new firms would aim to make a public offering of their shares in the future but did not elaborate.

CSK on Friday revised up its forecast for parent current profit for the six months to last September 30 to 2.40 billion yen. The compares with a previous forecast of a 1.30 billion yen profit and an actual 1.11 billion profit a year earlier.
The firm also forecast a full-year parent current profit of 5.20 billion yen, against 3.01 billion in 1995/96.
